comment: The section appropriately recognises that no country starts from zero. However, the legacy landscape is described mainly in terms of systems and tools rather than also including contracts, data assets, standards, workforce, infrastructure, governance bodies, and operating processes.

anchor.note: p.88 l.Lines 13-20 read as the printed page; section 4.1.1 agrees

public.text: The section appropriately recognises that no country starts from zero. However, the legacy landscape is described mainly in terms of systems and tools rather than also including contracts, data assets, standards, workforce, infrastructure, governance bodies, and operating processes.
public.suggestedRevision: Expand the legacy baseline to include systems, interfaces, data, identifiers, standards, contracts, licences, infrastructure, workforce capacity, governance arrangements, business processes, and current funding commitments.
